name: Oluwatobiloba ‘Icon’ Oreoluwa
bio: Oluwatobi “Icon” Oreoluwa is a creative entrepreneur, media executive and culture shaper. In 2021 he founded Street Church, which began with a small circle of friends putting scripture into Nigerian pidgin and the slang young people actually use, and sharing it on Twitter and Instagram. What started online has grown into a global community of more than one million people, with outposts in Ghana, Sierra Leone, the UK and Canada. Street Church is built for people who feel distant from traditional church settings and want a way back that feels honest and fun.

Beyond Street Church, he is the founder of Tasolo NG and Ashtag Team, and has shared his story on platforms including TEDx. Icon’s gift is making serious ideas approachable and helping people feel they belong in the conversation.

name: Ferdy Adimefe
bio: Ferdy Adimefe is a creative entrepreneur, producer and author building Africa’s animation and creative economy. He is the Founder of Magic Carpet, Group MD of Imaginarium which he started in Lagos in 2017. Magic Carpet is an innovation storytelling company committed to putting authentic African stories on the map. The studio is producing an animated adaptation of Cyprian Ekwensi’s classic novel The Passport of Mallam Ilia, working with about 90% Nigerian talent. He serves on the board of Slum2School Africa and is the author of the book Pulse.

He began his career in advertising as a copywriter, moved into strategy, and became a brand and communications manager before starting his entrepreneurial journey. He was a Ford Foundation inductee in 2010, tasked with creating a blueprint for Nigeria’s next 50 years, and has been named among The Future Awards’ best 100. He is also a member of the International Academy of Television Arts and Sciences, which presents the International Emmy Awards.

name: Alex Oyebade
bio: Alex Oyebade is the founder of Peercheck, a platform built to bring transparency to the African workplace. Peercheck aims to be the data layer for Africa’s workforce, giving job seekers insight into interviews, company culture and salaries across roles and industries. He writes about transparency, workplace culture and the future of Africa’s workforce, and argues that professionals have long shared this knowledge privately in DMs and WhatsApp groups, with no trusted place to put it. He describes himself as a believer, designer and builder.

name: Elizabeth Laiza Kalu
bio: Elizabeth Laiza Kalu is a global social impact leader, leadership development practitioner, and speaker. She is the Founder of the Global Talent & Leadership Institute and Beyond Borders Network, equipping professionals with leadership skills, visibility, and access to global opportunities. Her work across Africa and the United States spans education, financial inclusion, digital access, and economic opportunity, including initiatives involving Google, Facebook, and major financial institutions. Shaped by her experience living and working across countries, Laiza speaks on leadership, personal development, and strategic visibility. She is an alumna of Suffolk University and New York University.

name: Joseph ‘Jay On Air’ Onaolapo
bio: Joseph Onaolapo, popularly known as Jay On Air, is a media host, content creator, actor, and platform builder passionate about shaping meaningful conversations around work, leadership, culture, and influence in Africa.

He is the Founder and Curator of the Work Culture Festival (WCF), a culture-driven platform dedicated to rethinking how people work, lead, collaborate, and build in an evolving world. Through WCF, he brings together founders, executives, creatives, HR leaders, and young professionals to foster honest, thought-provoking, and future-focused conversations about workplace culture and the people shaping it.

He is also the host of Jay On Air, a media platform where he engages industry leaders, entrepreneurs, creatives, and change-makers in insightful conversations, unpacking their stories, experiences, ideas, and perspectives. Through his work across digital and live platforms, he continues to build an audience around conversations that inspire thought, challenge perspectives, and influence culture.

His work spans event hosting and moderation, conference and experience curation, content creation, acting, and performance. Whether commanding the stage, engaging audiences on screen, or building platforms behind the scenes, Joseph brings together storytelling, creativity, and intentional conversations to create experiences that resonate.

At the heart of his work is a commitment to creating platforms and conversations that matter, amplifying voices, connecting people, and contributing to the evolving conversations shaping Africa's work, culture, and leadership landscape.

name: Divine Egbuna
bio: Divine Egbuna is a creative entrepreneur, visionary thinker and multidisciplinary professional passionate about the intersection of creativity, technology, media and human potential.

Driven by a commitment to innovation, purposeful living and meaningful impact, Divine is interested in creating platforms, experiences and opportunities that inspire people to think beyond limitations, discover their identity and unlock their potential.

His approach to leadership is rooted in the belief that success goes beyond individual achievement. It is also about building meaningful relationships, creating access, sharing knowledge and cultivating communities where people can connect, collaborate and thrive.

With a keen interest in purpose, personal development, entrepreneurship and social capital, Divine is passionate about challenging conventional thinking and encouraging people to take ownership of their journeys, regardless of the odds stacked against them.
At the heart of his work is a simple conviction: that everyone has a purpose worth pursuing, a story worth telling and a contribution worth making.

Divine Egbuna is a Lead for MainQuest HQ, where he contributes to building a platform centred on purpose, identity, meaningful connections and empowering individuals to pursue their potential against all odds.
